title: Diffusion Models Observe Only Gradients: A Geometric Perspective on Score Matching Errors
abstract: arXiv:2606.06179v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Score-based diffusion models are typically trained by minimizing the $L^2$ score matching error, and standard theoretical analyses rely on this quantity to bound the sampling discrepancy between the learned and target distributions. Recent work has shown that the score admits an orthogonal decomposition into gradient and solenoidal components in which only the gradient part matters for exact sampling. We apply this decomposition to the score error of trained models and study its quantitative consequences. Since only the gradient component of the error enters the marginal Fokker-Planck dynamics, a model can incur arbitrarily large $L^2$ score error while perfectly matching the target. Starting from this observation, we present three results. First, we derive an upper bound on the Kullback-Leibler divergence that depends only on the observable gradient component of the error. translated_title: 扩散模型只观测到梯度：得分匹配误差的几何视角
translated_abstract: 基于得分的扩散模型通常通过最小化 L² 得分匹配误差来训练，标准理论分析也依赖该量来界定学习分布与目标分布之间的采样差异。近期研究表明，得分场可被正交分解为梯度分量与螺线（solenoidal）分量，其中只有梯度部分对精确采样起作用。我们将这一分解应用于训练所得模型的得分误差，并研究其定量后果。由于误差中只有梯度分量会进入边缘分布的 Fokker-Planck 动力学，模型即使产生任意大的 L² 得分误差，仍可完美匹配目标分布。基于这一观察，我们给出了三项结果。其一，我们推导出一个仅依赖于误差中可观测梯度分量的 KL 散度上界，该上界收紧了针对一般得分场（摘要原文在此截断）
tldr: 该论文从几何视角研究扩散模型的得分匹配误差，证明只有误差中可观测的梯度分量才影响采样质量（L² 得分误差即使任意大，模型仍可完美匹配目标分布），并据此推导出仅依赖该梯度分量的更紧 KL 散度上界。
en_tdlr: This paper takes a geometric perspective on score matching errors in diffusion models, showing that only the observable gradient component of the error affects sampling—arbitrarily large L2 score error can coexist with perfect target matching—and derives a tighter KL divergence upper bound depending solely on that component.
